movelist.name: Flail
movelist.effect: For each Injury the user has, Flail’s Damage Base is increased by +1.

movelist.name: Acid
movelist.effect: Acid lowers the target’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 18+.

movelist.name: Rain Dance
movelist.effect: The weather becomes Rainy for 5 rounds. While Rainy, Water-Type Attacks gain a +5 bonus to Damage Rolls, and Fire-Type Attacks suffer a -5 Damage penalty.

movelist.name: Muddy Water
movelist.effect: As a Shift Action, the user may Move to any open square in Muddy Water’s area of effect without provoking any Attacks of Opportunity. On 16+, the Accuracy of all targets is lowered by 1.

movelist.name: Uproar
movelist.effect: All Pokémon and Trainers within 5 meters of the user are cured of sleep.

movelist.name: Aqua Ring
movelist.effect: Aqua Ring covers the user in a Coat that heals the user at the beginning of their turn. The user is healed a Tick of Hit Points each turn.

abilities.name: Mud Dweller
abilities.effect: The user resists Ground-Type and Water-Type attacks one step further.

abilities.name: Poison Touch
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Moves which deal damage Poison Legal Targets on 19+. If a move already has a chance of Poisoning foes, Poison Touch increases the effect range by +2.

abilities.name: Refreshing Veil
abilities.effect: Connection – Aqua Ring. Whenever the user activates Aqua Ring, they may activate this Feature to cure themselves of all Persistent Status Effects.
